question: How do the three principal powers expand into six pure cognitions?
premises: From that stirring six immaculate cognitions are declared.
This occurs through their entry functioning as the power of action.
inference: The stirring of the three principal powers, as they enter into action, unfolds them into six pure cognitions.
uncertainties: The token saṃvido@malāḥ contains an editorial marker; the intended reading is taken as saṃvido'malāḥ.
plain_english: From the stirring of those powers, six immaculate cognitions are declared; this happens through their entry as the expressed power of action.
